text: annan1 , YANG Jianwen1\*(1.Department of Pharmacy, Affiliated Hospital of Zunyi Medical University, Zunyi 563003, China;2.Department of Pharmacy, The Third Affiliated Hospital of Zunyi Medical University/Zunyi First People’s Hospital, Zunyi 563099, China)ABSTRACT: OBJECTIVE To analyze the prescription of potential drug-drug interactions(pDDIs) between colchicine and statins, carry out risk assessment and formulate preventive measures. METHODS The case and research reports of adverse reactions caused by the interaction between colchicine and statins were retrieved from the databases of CNKI, VIP, Wanfang, PubMed and Elsevier, and the literature was analyzed;
